title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Location: Wymondham, Norfolk
Salary: £13.91 per hour
Contract: Temporary, up to 12 weeks
Start Date: ASAP
Hours: Full time, Monday Friday
Working Arrangement: On-site, hybrid minimum 3 days per week

We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Administrator to join the Finance team of a prestigious high-performance manufacturer based near Wymondham, Norfolk.

This is an exciting opportunity to work within a fast-paced manufacturing environment, supporting the Finance team with a range of accounts payable and general administration duties.

Key Responsibilities
- Accurately process supplier invoices within agreed timescales
- Process invoices and assist with VAT administration
- Complete financial data entry and maintain accurate records
- Investigate and resolve supplier queries
- Reconcile supplier statements against ledger balances
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve invoice queries and approval issues
- Manage supplier debit notes and cancellations
- Prepare supplier payment runs and post transactions to the cash book
- Carry out reconciliations and error checks on control accounts and intercompany balances
- Maintain accurate information within the finance system
- Distribute and file supplier correspondence and documentation
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and support relevant teams with training

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have previous Accounts Payable experience, although this is not essential. We're looking for someone who is:
- Organised, proactive and able to take ownership of their work
- Confident working independently and as part of a team
- A strong communicator with a professional, customer-focused approach
- Comfortable working with data and financial information
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Educated to GCSE Grade C or above (or equivalent) in Maths and English

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant
Location: Snetterton Salary 30,000 to 35,000 + Excellent Benefits Type: Full Time Permanent

Join a Growing, Innovative Business
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Assistant to join a successful and growing organisation operating within a highly innovative technical and engineering environment.
This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to develop their career within a supportive team, gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting, bookkeeping and financial administration activities.
Working closely with the Financial Controller and wider business teams, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate processing, reconciliations, reporting and financial administration.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain accurate financial records and process daily bookkeeping activities.
- Process sales invoices, receipts and payments, ensuring transactions are correctly recorded and allocated.
- Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and investigate any discrepancies.
- Post purchase invoices and allocate costs to the correct nominal codes and cost centres.
- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations, resolving any differences identified.
- Support the preparation and submission of VAT returns.
- Prepare and post journals with appropriate supporting documentation.
- Assist with month-end activities and the production of financial reports and management information.
- Support purchasing activities, including raising purchase orders and liaising with suppliers.
- Respond to finance-related queries from internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
- Maintain organised and accessible financial records and documentation.
- Identify opportunities to improve finance processes and efficiencies.
- Provide general administrative and finance support to the Financial Controller and wider finance team.

About You
We're looking for a motivated finance professional who enjoys working accurately, solving problems and supporting colleagues across the business.

Essential Skills & Experience
- A relevant finance qualification such as AAT, part-qualified accountancy qualification, or equivalent.
- Previous experience within a finance, accounts administration or bookkeeping role.
- Good understanding of bookkeeping and basic accounting principles.
- Experience processing sales and purchase invoices.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and standard Microsoft Office applications.
- Strong organisational abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable Experience
- Experience using an ERP or finance system such as IFS, SAP, Oracle, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics or similar.
- Experience completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Knowledge of VAT processes and returns.
- Experience managing purchase orders, supplier invoices and cost centre allocations.
- Exposure to month-end processes and management reporting.

Personal Attributes
The successful candidate will:
- Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
- Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
- Be a collaborative team player with a positive attitude.
- Manage workloads effectively and consistently meet deadlines.
- Show initiative and take a proactive approach to problem solving.
- Adapt positively to changing priorities and business needs.

Salary and Benefits
- Salary: Up to 35,000 + discretionary bonus
- Working pattern: onsite in Snetterton
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- Pension
- Healthcare
- Life Assurance
- Study support and professional development opportunities
- Friendly and collaborative team culture
- Additional company benefits

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
We are looking for a Purchase Ledger Clerk to join a busy and friendly finance team. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in finance, with some previous accounts or finance administration experience.
- Processing and coding supplier invoices onto the accounting system.
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery notes.
- Checking invoices and resolving any discrepancies.
- Setting up and maintaining supplier accounts.
- Reconciling supplier statements.
- Assisting with supplier payment runs.
- Handling supplier queries and general purchase ledger administration.
- Providing wider support to the finance team when required.

Some previous experience in accounts, purchase ledger or finance administration would be an advantage but not essential.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their finance career who is keen to build their experience within a supportive team.

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
Sales Ledger / Accounts Receivable Assistant

Working closely with the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of day-to-day sales ledger activity, ensuring accounts are accurate, payments are received on time and outstanding balances are managed effectively.

You'll be joining a successful business with a strong reputation for delivering technically complex projects, working with customers across a range of specialist markets. The business continues to develop and invest in its operations, providing an interesting environment in which to build your finance experience.

The Role
- Raising sales invoices and credit notes, and maintaining the daily sales register
- Allocating customer payments and reconciling the sales ledger to the general ledger
- Monitoring outstanding balances and following up overdue payments
- Dealing with customer account queries and resolving discrepancies
- Preparing aged debt reports and reviewing overdue accounts
- Leading weekly accounts receivable meetings to review outstanding balances
- Maintaining accurate records and supporting improvements to finance processes

About You

You'll have previous experience in a Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable or Credit Control role and be confident managing customer accounts and resolving payment queries.

You'll be organised, accurate and comfortable communicating with colleagues and customers at different levels. Experience using SAP would be useful, but isn't essential.

Please apply online or contact Justin Murray at Big Sky Additions for further information.
